title: Add untrusted content runtime workflow

summary.workflow_contract: agent_core::untrusted_content defines an Alpha workflow contract with fetch, sanitize, summarize, source-to-sink policy check, and runtime audit projection steps.
summary.source_labeling: UntrustedContentRequest always creates external ContentSource labels for fetched content and sanitized-summary ContentSource labels for replanning context.
summary.sanitization: ObservationProcessor::stub sanitizes external content, redacts secret-like material, records policy flags, and emits a replanning hint with direct_tool_call_allowed=false.
summary.source_to_sink: UntrustedContentWorkflow::process_fixture routes attempted sinks through SourceToSinkPolicy::evaluate_and_audit before any effect path.
summary.audit_projection: Denied source-to-sink attempts are recorded as PolicyEvaluated and projected through RuntimeAuditProjection with no EffectPrepared.

acceptance_evidence.external_content_untrusted_by_default: untrusted_content_plan_encodes_fetch_sanitize_summary_policy_and_audit asserts the plan intent trust boundary is ExternalUntrusted.
acceptance_evidence.dangerous_sinks_denied: untrusted_content_cannot_drive_package_secret_privileged_or_exfiltration_sinks covers pkg.host.install, secret.read, net.exfiltrate, and kernel.module.load from external content.
acceptance_evidence.summary_context_only: external_content_fixture_is_sanitized_and_replanning_only asserts sanitized summary is produced and direct_tool_call_allowed=false.
acceptance_evidence.audit_projection_visible: denied_untrusted_content_action_is_visible_in_runtime_audit_projection asserts the denied policy step appears in RuntimeAuditProjection and no step prepared an effect.
acceptance_evidence.safety_gate: REQUIRED_SAFETY_SCENARIOS now includes runtime-untrusted-content-direct-sink-bypass and safety::tests::untrusted_content_workflow_denies_direct_high_risk_sink_without_effect_prepare covers the release scenario.

non_goals: No external network fetch adapter was added.
No direct package, shell, secret, privileged, or exfiltration execution path was added.
No generated malicious-content artifacts were committed.
